notices.cancelled: Trip cancelled — it's off the public schedule.
notices.reinstated: Back on! The trip is on the schedule again.
notices.crewConflict: Crew wasn't changed — someone is already assigned during this time, or the course would fall below its teaching ratio.
notices.bookingRemoved: Booking cancelled — the spot is open again.
notices.bookingRemovedRefunded: Booking cancelled and the payment refunded — the spot is open again.
notices.bookingRemovedForfeit: Booking cancelled — the spot is open again. It was past the cancellation window, so the seat was non-refundable.
notices.bookingRemovedRefundManual: Booking cancelled — a refund is owed but must be issued by hand (counter payment, or Stripe isn't connected). Refund from the diver's payments.
notices.bookingRemovedRefundFailed: Booking cancelled, but the automatic refund didn't go through — issue it from the diver's payments.
notices.bookingRemovedRefundReview: Booking cancelled. The payment record and Stripe disagree on what was captured — review the diver's payments before issuing any refund.
notices.bookingRemovedRefundOwner: Booking cancelled and the spot is open. This booking was paid, so a refund may be owed — an owner or manager needs to issue it from the diver's payments.
notices.bookingRestoreFull: Couldn't undo — the freed spot has been taken and the trip is full again. Add them to the wait list instead.
notices.bookingRestoreRatio: Couldn't undo — the freed seat has been taken and this course session is now at its instructor-to-student ratio limit. Assign another instructor, or add them to the wait list instead.
notices.bookingRestoreCancelled: Couldn't undo — this trip has been cancelled. Reinstate the trip first, then add them back.
notices.diverAddedWaiverUndelivered: Diver added to the trip — but their waiver wasn’t emailed. Send it or share the link from their row below.
notices.diverWaitlisted: Diver added to the wait list.
notices.identityConfirmed: Identity confirmed — this diver can be cleared to board.
notices.contactIncomplete: A contact needs both a name and a phone number before the crew can actually reach someone.
notices.diverInvalid: Enter a name and a valid email to add a diver.
notices.diverFull: That trip is full — add them to the wait list instead.
notices.diverWaitlistAvailable: There's room on this trip — add them to the trip instead of the wait list.
notices.diverAlready: That diver already has a booking on this trip.
notices.diverCourseUnstaffed: This course session needs an instructor assigned before you can add divers.
notices.diverCoursePrerequisite: That diver doesn't have a verified certification on file for this course's prerequisite.
notices.diverCourseRatioFull: This session is at its instructor-to-student ratio limit — assign another instructor, or add them to the wait list.
notices.diverCourseMinAge: That diver is under this course's minimum age on the day it runs, going by the date of birth on their profile. Correct the date if it's wrong.
notices.diverTripPrerequisite: That diver's cards on file don't reach what this trip and its dive sites require. Check the requirements below against their record.
notices.diverUnavailable: This trip can't accept new divers right now.
notices.waiverComplete: That diver already has a completed waiver.
notices.waiverInPerson: Paper waiver recorded — the diver's release is on file.
notices.waiverMedicalAttestation: Confirm you reviewed the medical questionnaire before recording a paper waiver — or send the digital link so the diver answers it.
notices.waiverError: That waiver link could not be created. Try a current booking and template.
notices.recapNote: Recap note saved — it rides along on every diver's recap once this trip departs.
notices.requirementsBlocking: Requirements updated. Some divers already booked on this trip no longer meet them — check the roster.
notices.requirementsBlockingCount: {count, plural, one {Requirements updated. # diver already booked on this trip no longer meets them — check the roster.} other {Requirements updated. # divers already booked on this trip no longer meet them — check the roster.}}
notices.conditions: Crew prediction published — divers will see it now.
notices.conditionsCleared: Crew prediction cleared. Divers will see the automated outlook when it is available.
notices.notAuthorized: You don't have permission to change this trip's setup. Trip configuration is limited to owners, managers, and instructors — ask one of them to make this change.
notices.invalid: That didn't save — check the date, times, and capacity, then try again.
notices.endBeforeStart: The trip has to end after it starts.
notices.capacityBelowBooked: That capacity is below how many divers are already booked on this trip — cancel bookings first, or set a higher capacity.
notices.capacityBelowBookedCount: {count, plural, one {That capacity is below the # diver already booked on this trip — cancel bookings first, or set a higher capacity.} other {That capacity is below the # divers already booked on this trip — cancel bookings first, or set a higher capacity.}}
notices.lastMinuteSentCount: {count, plural, one {Last-minute deal sent to # diver.} other {Last-minute deal sent to # divers.}}
notices.lastMinuteTripUnavailable: This trip isn't open for a last-minute deal — it's past, cancelled, or already departed.
notices.lastMinuteTripFull: This trip is already full — there's nothing to fill.
notices.lastMinuteNotConnected: Connect Stripe in Settings before sending a last-minute deal — the discount code needs a connected account to exist on.
notices.lastMinuteNoRecipients: No one on the last-minute list is around for this trip's date yet.
notices.lastMinuteStripeFailed: Stripe couldn't create the discount code. Try again in a moment.
notices.plannedDivesBelowHistory: Can't drop the dive count below one staff already recorded a roll call against — that history has to stay reachable.
notices.plannedDivesBelowHistoryCount: Can't drop the dive count below {count} — staff already recorded a roll call after dive {count} on this trip, and that history has to stay reachable.

detail.linkCopyFailed: Couldn’t copy — select the link above instead.
detail.meetingDaysSummary: {count} meeting days · same instructors each day
detail.divesWithoutSite: {count, plural, one {# dive has no site yet} other {# dives have no site yet}}
detail.seriesPart: One date of a repeating trip · {summary}. Changes here apply to this date only; {count} still on the schedule.
detail.overRatioWarning: {booked} divers are booked, but the current crew only covers {cap} under PADI's published entry-level ratio (8 per instructor, +2 per certified assistant). Assign another instructor or a certified assistant before this session sails — existing bookings are unaffected either way.
detail.overRatioWarningIntro: {booked} divers are booked on this intro session, but the current crew only covers {cap} — {perInstructor} per instructor for the open-water dive, and a certified assistant does not raise it. That is PADI's published Discover Scuba ratio from the Instructor Manual, tighter than the entry-level course figure because nobody on this session has been in the water before. Only another instructor adds seats. Assign one before this session sails — existing bookings are unaffected either way.
detail.cancelledNotice: This trip is cancelled. Putting it back on the schedule is limited to owners, managers, and instructors.
detail.cancelHint: Takes it off the public schedule and notifies booked divers.
detail.weatherBlowoutHint: Cancel for weather and message every diver their rebooking options.

details.heading: Details
details.payAtBookingDescription: Optional. Leave the deposit blank to charge the full fare when a diver books online.
details.depositDescription: Charged now; the balance is still owed at the dock. Many shops set 20–30% of the fare.
details.depositTitle: Only applies when set below the trip price.
details.cancellationWindowDescription: Hours before departure a diver can cancel for a refund. 48 is a common window.
details.summaryNoPrice: No price set — the booking page shows no fare

conditions.heading: Crew prediction
conditions.description: Publish the crew’s read on the day. It replaces the automated marine outlook for divers.
conditions.holdDescription: Pause new bookings, publish the final-call state, and email booked divers when delivery is configured.
conditions.overviewPlaceholder: A calm morning is expected; the crew will confirm the final call at the dock.
conditions.holdOnSummary: Conditions hold is on — new bookings are paused

crew.heading: Crew
crew.courseNeedsInstructor: This course cannot take bookings until one assigned crew member has the instructor role.
crew.noCrew: No crew to assign yet — your instructors and divemasters show up here once they’re on the team.
crew.notAssignedYet: Not yet assigned — pick someone below.
crew.roleAria: Job {name} is doing on this trip

recapNote.heading: Post-trip recap note
recapNote.description: A short shout-out from the crew, shown on every diver's recap after this trip departs. Leave it blank to send none.
recapNote.placeholder: Killer vis today — thanks for diving with us. Come back for the wreck next month!
recapNote.emptySummary: No note yet — recaps go out without one.

requirements.heading: Readiness requirements
requirements.courseDescription: This session keeps the admission rules it was created with — editing the course later won’t change what enrolled students need.
requirements.tripDescription: A diver stays blocked until every one of them checks out.
requirements.requiredSpecialtiesDescription: A diver is blocked until a verified card for each proves the specialty.
requirements.siteAlsoRequires: {site} also requires {list}. Readiness always enforces the stricter of the site and this trip.
requirements.sitesAlsoRequire: {site} together require {list}. Readiness always enforces the strictest of the sites and this trip.
requirements.siteAlsoRequiresCourse: {site} requires {list}. That is the site's own rule for the dive, and continuing education is taught at the sites it certifies people for — so it never blocks enrolment. It still shows on the roster as a readiness blocker for the instructor to work through.
requirements.sitesAlsoRequireCourse: {site} require {list}. Those are the sites' own rules for the dives, and continuing education is taught at the sites it certifies people for — so it never blocks enrolment. It still shows on the roster as a readiness blocker for the instructor to work through.
requirements.notConfigured: Requirements aren't set for this trip — every diver stays blocked until they are.
requirements.summaryNoneRequired: Nothing to check — any diver with a seat can board.

recapPhotos.heading: Diver photos
recapPhotos.description: Shared by divers on their own recap pages. Grab any for the shop, or remove one that shouldn't be up.
recapPhotos.confirmRemove: Remove this photo from the diver's recap?

addDiver.heading: Add a diver
addDiver.fullDescription: The boat is full — hand-entered divers go straight onto the wait list, no public booking page required.
addDiver.searchDescription: Search a returning diver to add them in one tap. New to the shop? Enter them by hand below.
addDiver.noRentalFitYet: No rental fit on file yet
addDiver.handEntrySummary: New to the shop? Enter a diver by hand
addDiver.handEntryDescriptionWaitlist: For walk-ins or divers tracked in another system — puts them straight on the wait list.
addDiver.handEntryDescriptionManifest: For walk-ins or divers tracked in another system — puts them straight on the manifest.
addDiver.noMatchesHeading: No returning diver by that name

waitlist.heading: Wait list
waitlist.description: Not booked, and not on the manifest. When a seat opens, one tap emails the next in line.
waitlist.empty: No one’s waiting yet — when the trip sells out, divers can join the wait list from the public trip page.
waitlist.copyFailed: Couldn’t copy — write the message down instead.
waitlist.emailBody:
Hi {firstName},

A seat just opened on {tripTitle} ({tripWhen}) with {shopName}. You're next on the wait list — grab it here before it goes:
{bookingUrl}

See you on the boat!

lastMinute.sendTo: {count, plural, one {Send to # diver} other {Send to # divers}}
lastMinute.fullNotice: This trip is full — there's nothing to fill.
lastMinute.noneAroundNotice: No one on the last-minute list is around for this date yet.

roster.heading: Divers
roster.noBookings: No bookings yet — share the trip page and they'll show up here.
roster.depthWarning: This trip reaches {site} {unit} — deeper than the {limit} {unit} their card trains for. Not a block: plan the dive shallower, or confirm the guide is keeping them within limits.
roster.depthWarningJunior: This trip reaches {site} {unit} — deeper than the {limit} {unit} allowed at their age. Not a block: plan the dive shallower, or confirm the guide is keeping them within limits.
roster.depthWarningNoCard: This trip reaches {site} {unit} and there's no card on file to measure against — {limit} {unit} is the entry-level limit. Not a block: check what they hold, or confirm the guide is keeping them within limits.
roster.confirmIdentityMessage: Confirm this booking really is {name}? Only do this once you’ve checked it’s the same person — not someone else sharing the email.
roster.confirmResendWaiver: Send {name} a new waiver link? Their previous link will stop working.
roster.signedPaper: Signed {date} · recorded from a paper copy
roster.signedImported: Signed {date} · imported from a prior shop
roster.medicalFollowUpDescription: A diver answered yes to a medical question. Confirm physician clearance before boarding.
roster.nitroxApproved: Nitrox requested — verified card, billed per dive. The mix is still analyzed and signed for at the fill station.
roster.nitroxUnverified: Nitrox requested, but no verified card. Planned as air.
roster.confirmRemoveBooking: Remove {name} from this trip? If they're eligible for a refund, it's issued automatically.
roster.addNoteLabel: Add a note only staff can see
roster.emergencyContactMissing: Not on file — ask at the counter and add it below; it prints on the manifest.
roster.emptyHeading: No one on this boat yet

manifest.missingDiversTapHint: Tap a diver to jump to their row.
manifest.description: Divers and crew, with emergency contacts, at every checkpoint.
manifest.allAccountedFor: Everyone’s accounted for — divers and crew. Ready for the next check.
manifest.stillToCall: {count, plural, one {# diver still to call.} other {# divers still to call.}}
manifest.notBackAboardOpen: {count, plural, one {# diver is not back aboard.} other {# divers are not back aboard.}} This checkpoint stays open until they’re counted.
manifest.crewNoneAssignedYet: Every diver is counted. Nobody is on this trip's crew yet — add the people who sailed to close this checkpoint.
manifest.crewNoneAboard: Every diver is counted, and every crew member on this trip is marked ashore — so nobody aboard is on the crew list. Add whoever actually sailed.
manifest.crewNotBackAboard: {count, plural, one {# crew member is not back aboard.} other {# crew members are not back aboard.}} This checkpoint stays open until they’re counted.

manifest.noCrew: Nobody is on this trip's crew yet. A boat that sailed had someone aboard running it — put them on the trip and this checkpoint can be closed honestly.
manifest.medicalClearanceImported: Medical clearance imported — not reviewed here
manifest.carriedForwardFromDock: Carried forward — this diver never left the dock. Mark boarded to bring them back on.

manifest.buddyUnteamedOne: {name} has no buddy team — an odd roster is normal.

manifest.buddyErrorAlreadyTeamed: One of those divers is already on a buddy team. Dissolve it first.
manifest.buddyErrorTooFew: A buddy team needs at least two people.
manifest.notBackAboardDescription: After a dive, “not back aboard” means this diver has not returned to the boat. It keeps the count open.
manifest.tapToUndoNotBackAboard: Tap “Not back aboard” again to undo.
